text: On a Saturday, Aziz logs in to the mobile bank with his password and a code.
prefix: On a Saturday, Aziz logs in to the mobile bank with his password and a code.

text: The password is right, and the code is right.
prefix: The password is right, and the code is right.

text: The mobile bank opens for him.
prefix: The mobile bank opens for him.

text: He wants to send money to his mother.
prefix: He wants to send money to his mother.

text: But the money does not move.
prefix: But the money does not move.

text: His password and his code are both right, so why are they not enough for money?
prefix: His password and his code are both right, so why are they not enough for money?

text: Lesson 1 showed this Saturday as one step of his journey, and it drew the map of the platform.
prefix: Lesson 1 showed this Saturday as one step of his journey, and it drew the map of the platform.

text: This lesson gives the three words behind that step, and it explains what a level is.
prefix: This lesson gives the three words behind that step, and it explains what a level is.

text: Each word checks a different thing.
prefix: Each word checks a different thing.

text: The first word is authentication.
prefix: The first word is authentication.

text: Authentication checks that this is the owner of the account.
prefix: Authentication checks that this is the owner of the account.

text: Aziz shows something he knows, his password, and something he has, his phone, which gets the code.
prefix: Aziz shows something he knows, his password, and something he has, his phone, which gets the code.

text: Notice what authentication does not say.
prefix: Notice what authentication does not say.

text: It does not say that this is Aziz from the state records.
prefix: It does not say that this is Aziz from the state records.

text: It says only that this is the person who registered the account.
prefix: It says only that this is the person who registered the account.

text: A stranger can register with his own phone and his own password, and he passes authentication every day.
prefix: A stranger can register with his own phone and his own password, and he passes authentication every day.

text: The second word is identity proofing.
prefix: The second word is identity proofing.

text: Identity proofing checks that this is a real person in the state records.
prefix: Identity proofing checks that this is a real person in the state records.

text: heeyID does it in one way only: MyID, in the mobile bank.
prefix: heeyID does it in one way only: MyID, in the mobile bank.

text: MyID compares a live face and a passport with the state records.
prefix: MyID compares a live face and a passport with the state records.

text: Proofing is slow, and Aziz does it one time.
prefix: Proofing is slow, and Aziz does it one time.

text: Authentication is fast, and it happens at every login.
prefix: Authentication is fast, and it happens at every login.

text: The most common mistake in identity work is to treat a strong login as proof of a person.
prefix: The most common mistake in identity work is to treat a strong login as proof of a person.

text: A password and a code prove that you hold the account, not who you are.
prefix: A password and a code prove that you hold the account, not who you are.

text: The third word is authorisation.
prefix: The third word is authorisation.

text: Authorisation decides what this session may do, now.
prefix: Authorisation decides what this session may do, now.

text: The rule is simple: money data and the verified identity need level two.
prefix: The rule is simple: money data and the verified identity need level two.

text: Cards, accounts and transfers are money data.
prefix: Cards, accounts and transfers are money data.

text: The app's own data needs only level one.
prefix: The app's own data needs only level one.

text: That rule stopped the transfer.
prefix: That rule stopped the transfer.

text: heeyID has three levels.
prefix: heeyID has three levels.

text: At level zero, nothing is verified.
prefix: At level zero, nothing is verified.

text: At level one, a code verified the phone number.
prefix: At level one, a code verified the phone number.

text: At level two, MyID proved the person, and the phone number is confirmed as his.
prefix: At level two, MyID proved the person, and the phone number is confirmed as his.

text: Only the check for a level gives that level.
prefix: Only the check for a level gives that level.

text: No operator and no setting puts a person at level two without MyID.
prefix: No operator and no setting puts a person at level two without MyID.

text: A person has a level, and each session has a level too.
prefix: A person has a level, and each session has a level too.

text: A session in the mobile bank gets level two only on the trusted phone.
prefix: A session in the mobile bank gets level two only on the trusted phone.

text: The trusted phone is the one phone where Aziz passed MyID, and where TAF confirmed his SIM card.
prefix: The trusted phone is the one phone where Aziz passed MyID, and where TAF confirmed his SIM card.

text: Only a session on that phone moves money.
prefix: Only a session on that phone moves money.

text: On that Saturday, Aziz is still at level one, and his phone is not trusted.
prefix: On that Saturday, Aziz is still at level one, and his phone is not trusted.

text: The app does not refuse him.
prefix: The app does not refuse him.

text: It names the level that it needs, and the check that gives that level.
prefix: It names the level that it needs, and the check that gives that level.

text: First his consent, then MyID, then the check of his phone number.
prefix: First his consent, then MyID, then the check of his phone number.

text: Aziz passes all three, and he is at level two.
prefix: Aziz passes all three, and he is at level two.

text: His phone becomes the trusted phone, and the transfer to his mother goes.
prefix: His phone becomes the trusted phone, and the transfer to his mother goes.

text: Same person, same password: the level and the phone make the difference.
prefix: Same person, same password: the level and the phone make the difference.

text: Keycloak issues the tokens for the app, and each token holds the level of its session.
prefix: Keycloak issues the tokens for the app, and each token holds the level of its session.

text: heeyID has no token format of its own.
prefix: heeyID has no token format of its own.

text: The tokens follow two open standards, and their names are in every identity document.
prefix: The tokens follow two open standards, and their names are in every identity document.

text: OAuth 2.1 says how an app gets a token, and what the token lets it do.
prefix: OAuth 2.1 says how an app gets a token, and what the token lets it do.

text: OpenID Connect sits on top of it, and adds who logged in, and how.
prefix: OpenID Connect sits on top of it, and adds who logged in, and how.

text: The mobile bank reads the level of the session, and decides.
prefix: The mobile bank reads the level of the session, and decides.

text: So why did the right password and the right code not move his money?
prefix: So why did the right password and the right code not move his money?

text: Because they pass only authentication, and money needs level two on the trusted phone.
prefix: Because they pass only authentication, and money needs level two on the trusted phone.

text: Authentication checks the owner of the account.
prefix: Authentication checks the owner of the account.

text: Identity proofing checks the real person, one time, with MyID.
prefix: Identity proofing checks the real person, one time, with MyID.

text: Authorisation decides what each session may do, from its level.
prefix: Authorisation decides what each session may do, from its level.

text: Today, Aziz is at level two, and his phone is the money phone.
prefix: Today, Aziz is at level two, and his phone is the money phone.
